title: Perfect Parking 3D
description: Drive three toy vehicles through a bright miniature parking lot, clear timed challenges, avoid obstacles, and earn precision scores.

mintAssets.brief: Three vehicles with bays, cones, barriers, bollards, a booth, asphalt, and curbs.
Engine, tire, collision, countdown, and success sounds.

experience: Choose a compact, sports car, or van in a miniature lot.
Balance speed, alignment, and damage across parking challenges.
prompt.visualDirection: A bright diorama with toy vehicles, painted asphalt, coral and teal accents, and clear UI.

thumbnail.alt: A bright toy car lining up with a marked parking bay in a miniature lot.
